# ASZ Technologies

> ASZ Technologies is a global technology and engineering company. We build AI systems, intelligent security, digital products and enterprise technology: secure, scalable software that solves complex business challenges. Contact: info@asztechnologies.com

We work as an extension of our clients' teams, from strategy through to shipped product and ongoing operations, and build tailored solutions across 12+ industries.

## Services

- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://asztechnologies.com/service/ai-intelligence): AI agents, generative AI, machine learning in production
- [Smart Security Systems](https://asztechnologies.com/service/smart-security): facial recognition, vehicle recognition (ANPR), access control, visitor management
- [Enterprise Systems & ERP](https://asztechnologies.com/service/enterprise-erp): ERP implementation, CRM integration
- [Product & Application Engineering](https://asztechnologies.com/service/product-application): product development, application modernisation
- [Digital Transformation & Cloud](https://asztechnologies.com/service/digital-transformation): technology strategy, cloud transformation
- [Technology Talent & Engineering](https://asztechnologies.com/service/technology-talent): dedicated engineering teams, staff augmentation

## Products

- [Cordon](https://asztechnologies.com/products/cordon): zero-touch, AI-powered security and access control for modern premises
- [MEDIQ](https://asztechnologies.com/products/mediq): self-service technology for hospital registration, payments and patient services
- [JobScout](https://jobsscout.in/): AI-powered career discovery platform
- [Safin](https://safinwater.com/): smart water monitoring for real-time tank levels and water quality

## Case studies

- [Mega Adventure Park](https://asztechnologies.com/case-study/mega-adventure-park): self-service media commerce, 35% higher purchase conversion
- [Faith-based organization](https://asztechnologies.com/case-study/faith-based-organization): centralised ERP, one source of truth
- [78 Shenton Way](https://asztechnologies.com/case-study/78-shenton-way): visitor management system, automated access
